name: pythonic-code
description: >- Write, refactor, and review Python for clarity, explicit behavior, local reasoning, strong types, constructive domain modeling, and minimal abstraction. Use when creating or changing nontrivial Python, simplifying object-heavy, helper-heavy, or overly procedural code, evaluating whether code is Pythonic, or reviewing Python maintainability in Basic Memory repositories.
author: basicmachines-co
summary_zh: 一套用于编写、重构和审查复杂 Python 代码的方法，帮助减少过度抽象与臃肿结构，提升清晰度和可维护性。
